children: Sanmina's revenue rose 79% and earnings increased year over year, primarily reflecting the consolidation of ZT Systems, which contributed $5B in net sales. Gross margin increased to 9.6% from 8.8%, driven by a higher-margin mix of complex AI compute infrastructure and rack-scale programs and favorable product mix.
¹ Reported as “Net sales”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to common shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Acquired on October 27, 2025; contributed $5B in net sales and expanded cloud and AI infrastructure manufacturing.
: Communications networks, cloud and AI infrastructure sales surged 198% to $9.3B, including acquisition effects and a 30% increase in new program wins and ramps.
: Revenue grew 89.9% to $12.4B; excluding ZT Systems, growth reflected strong demand and program volume ramps in communications networks.
: Revenue increased 33.4% to $2.2B, primarily on higher demand and volume shipments across advanced components and specialized products.
: IMS gross margin rose to 9.6% from 7.7%; CPS gross margin fell to 12.3% from 13.9%, primarily due to product mix.
